form.label: L2T - Chrome Browser Forensics
form.description: Comprehensive browser activity and Google services analysis for digital forensics and user behavior investigation

search.query: (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ | stats count by hostname | sort hostname
(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ | stats count by username | sort username
(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ | stats count by description_short | sort description_short
(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ | stats count by timestamp_desc | sort timestamp_desc

(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count

(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "https?://(?<domain>[^/]+)" | eval service_domain=coalesce(domain, display_name) | stats dc(service_domain)

(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "https?://(?<domain>[^/]+)" | eval activity_risk=case( like(message, "*download*") AND (like(message, "*.exe") OR like(message, "*.zip")), "High", match(domain, "(?i).*(temp|bit\.ly|tinyurl|pastebin).*"), "Medium", like(message, "*incognito*") OR like(message, "*private*"), "Medium", sourcetype="l2t:Google" AND like(display_name, "*deleted*"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | eval service_domain=coalesce(domain, display_name) | eval content_preview=if(len(message)>80, substr(message,1,80)+"...", message) | eval data_source=case( sourcetype="l2t:Chrome", "Chrome", sourcetype="l2t:Google", "Google", true(), "Other" ) | table datetime, hostname, username, data_source, description_short, timestamp_desc, service_domain, content_preview, activity_risk, filename | sort activity_risk

(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval data_source=case( sourcetype="l2t:Chrome", "Chrome Browser", sourcetype="l2t:Google", "Google Services", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by data_source

(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "https?://(?<domain>[^/]+)" | eval service_name=case( sourcetype="l2t:Google", display_name, isnotnull(domain), domain, true(), "Unknown" ) | where service_name!="Unknown" | stats count by service_name, sourcetype | sort -count | head 15

(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count by username, sourcetype | sort -count | head 20

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | dedup display_name | eval google_service=case( like(display_name, "*gmail*") OR like(display_name, "*mail*"), "Gmail", like(display_name, "*drive*"), "Google Drive", like(display_name, "*calendar*"), "Google Calendar", like(display_name, "*docs*"), "Google Docs", like(display_name, "*sheets*"), "Google Sheets", like(display_name, "*search*"), "Google Search", like(display_name, "*youtube*"), "YouTube", like(display_name, "*maps*"), "Google Maps", like(display_name, "*photos*"), "Google Photos", true(), "Other Google Service" ) | stats count as activity_count, values(description_short) as activity_types, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen, values(username) as users by google_service, display_name | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -activity_count | head 15

(index=host sourcetype="l2t:Chrome") OR (index=host sourcetype="l2t:Google") | search sourcetype=$dataSource$ hostname=$hostFilter$ username=$userFilter$ description_short=$activityFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$urlSearch$*" OR display_name="*$urlSearch$*" OR filename="*$urlSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "https?://(?<domain>[^/]+)" | eval risk_level=case( like(message, "*download*") AND (like(message, "*.exe") OR like(message, "*.zip") OR like(message, "*.rar")), "High", match(domain, "(?i).*(temp|bit\.ly|tinyurl|pastebin|mega|dropbox).*"), "Medium", like(message, "*incognito*") OR like(message, "*private*"), "Medium", match(domain, "(?i).*(tor|onion|darkweb).*"), "High", like(message, "*search*") AND (like(message, "*hack*") OR like(message, "*exploit*") OR like(message, "*malware*")), "Medium", like(description_short, "*cookie*") AND like(message, "*bank*"), "Medium", sourcetype="l2t:Google" AND like(display_name, "*deleted*"), "Medium", sourcetype="l2t:Google" AND like(message, "*private*"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | where risk_level!="Low" | eval service_domain=coalesce(domain, display_name) | stats count, values(description_short) as activity_types, values(sourcetype) as data_sources, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by service_domain, username, hostname, risk_level | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort risk_level
